The agent's extra local/passive/eye-data selection changes the population.

6-a.decision_correctness_justification: The reference uses pupil_width after excluding likely_blink frames. The agent instead derives equivalent-circle diameter from pupil_area; ellipse area is not generally equivalent to measured pupil width, so this changes labels beyond a guaranteed monotonic transform.
